# Skechers

> Official Skechers ecommerce site.

## Core Site
- [Homepage](https://www.skechers.com/)
- [Women](https://www.skechers.com/women/)
- [Men](https://www.skechers.com/men/)
- [Kids](https://www.skechers.com/kids/)
- [Work](https://www.skechers.com/work/)
- [Store Locator](https://www.skechers.com/stores/)

## Product Discovery
- [Sitemap](https://www.skechers.com/sitemap_index.xml)

## Blog and Guides
- [Skechers Stories](https://www.skechers.com/stories/): Official Skechers blog featuring footwear guides, comfort technology explanations, product stories, and brand news.

## Customer Information
- [Shipping Information](https://www.skechers.com/shipping/)
- [Returns](https://www.skechers.com/returns/)
- [Customer Service](https://www.skechers.com/help/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.skechers.com/privacy-policy/)
- [Terms of Use](https://www.skechers.com/terms/)

## Crawling Guidance
Please use canonical product and category URLs from the sitemap.
Do not treat cart, checkout, account, search result, or filtered URLs as authoritative content.
Respect robots.txt directives.

CQuotient.initFromCookies = function () {
	var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
	for(var i=0;i < ca.length;i++) {
	  var c = ca[i];
	  while (c.charAt(0)==' ') c = c.substring(1,c.length);
	  if (c.indexOf('cqcid=') == 0) {
		CQuotient.cqcid=c.substring('cqcid='.length,c.length);

		  	if (split_value.length > 0) {
			  CQuotient.cquid=split_value[0];
		  	}

		  	}
		  	if (split_value.length > 2) {
			  CQuotient.cqlid=split_value[2];
		  	}
		  }
	  }
	}
}

};
CQuotient.getCQUserId = function () {

};
CQuotient.getCQHashedEmail = function () {

};
CQuotient.getCQHashedLogin = function () {

};

try {
	if (Object.prototype.toString.call(events) === "[object Array]") {

	}
} catch(err) {}
};
CQuotient._trackASingleCQEvent = function ( /* Object */ event) {
	if (event && event.id) {
		if (event.type === dw.ac.EV_PRD_DETAIL) {
			CQuotient.trackViewProduct( {id:'', alt_id: event.id, type: 'raw_sku'} );

	}
};

	var cq_params = {};
	cq_params.cookieId = CQuotient.getCQCookieId();
	cq_params.userId = CQuotient.getCQUserId();
	cq_params.emailId = CQuotient.getCQHashedEmail();

	cq_params.realm = cqParamData.realm;
	cq_params.siteId = cqParamData.siteId;
	cq_params.instanceType = cqParamData.instanceType;
	cq_params.locale = CQuotient.locale;

		CQuotient.sendActivity(CQuotient.clientId, 'viewProduct', cq_params);

    (function() {
        window.CQuotient.widgets = window.CQuotient.widgets || [];
        const nativePush = window.CQuotient.widgets.push;

        function checkEmptyRecommendationSlots(args) {
            const recommSlots = document.querySelectorAll('div[id^="cq_recomm_slot-"]');
            recommSlots.forEach(slot => {
                const skeletonParent = slot.closest('.c-skeleton__loading');
                if (skeletonParent) {
                    const scriptInfo = skeletonParent.querySelectorAll('script');
                    const isSlot = Array.from(scriptInfo).some(script => 
                        script.textContent.includes(args.slotId)
                    );

                    const isEmpty = slot.children.length === 0 && slot.textContent.trim() === '';
                    if (isSlot && isEmpty) {
                        const skeletonChild = skeletonParent.querySelector('.skeleton-container');
                        skeletonChild.style.display = 'none';
                        skeletonParent.classList.add('no-recomendations');
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        window.CQuotient.widgets.push = function(args) {
            if (args !== null && typeof args === 'object' && args.recommenderName && args.callback && typeof args.callback === 'function') {
                const originalCallback = args.callback;
                const argsP = args.parameters;

                args.callback = function(response) {
                    let productRecommendations = null;
                    let args = argsP;
                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (Array.isArray(response.recs)) {
                            productRecommendations = response.recs;
                        } else {
                            const innerObjectWithRecs = Object.values(response).find(item => item !== null && typeof item === 'object' && Array.isArray(item.recs));
                            if (innerObjectWithRecs) {
                                productRecommendations = innerObjectWithRecs.recs;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (!productRecommendations || productRecommendations.length === 0) {
                        checkEmptyRecommendationSlots(args);
                    }
                    return originalCallback.apply(this, arguments);
                };
            }
            return nativePush.apply(window.CQuotient.widgets, [args]);
        };
    })();
</script>

    <script>
        (function() {
            var CC_DARK_LAUNCH = true;

            // Dark launch: hides the widget from shoppers by default while cc_enabled
            // stays true. Testers reveal it for the current tab session by running
            // enableAgent() in the browser console — no reload required.
            function shouldShowAgent() {
                if (!CC_DARK_LAUNCH) return true;
                try {
                    return sessionStorage.getItem(CC_OVERRIDE_KEY) === '1';
                } catch (e) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

                var mod = window.CimulateMessaging;
                if (!mod || !mod.injectMessagingWidget) {
                    console.error('[CommerceClient] CimulateMessaging.injectMessagingWidget not available.');
                    return;

                if (!shouldShowAgent()) {
                    console.info('[CommerceClient] Dark launch active — run enableAgent() in the console to show the agent.');
                    return;

                activateAgent();
            }

            // window.enableAgent() is exposed unconditionally within this
            // config.enabled && isConfigured block so testers can reveal a
            // dark-launched agent without a page reload.
            window.enableAgent = function() {

            // it hides the agent again in the current tab without a reload and
            // clears the dark-launch override so it stays hidden on subsequent
            // navigations. NOTE: this only persists while the agent is dark-launched

            // shouldShowAgent() always returns true, so a reload re-injects the

            window.disableAgent = function() {

CQuotient.useTest = ('true' === 'false');
CQuotient.initFromCookies = function () {
	var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
	for(var i=0;i < ca.length;i++) {
	  var c = ca[i];
	  while (c.charAt(0)==' ') c = c.substring(1,c.length);
	  if (c.indexOf('cqcid=') == 0) {
		CQuotient.cqcid=c.substring('cqcid='.length,c.length);
	  } else if (c.indexOf('cquid=') == 0) {
		  var value = c.substring('cquid='.length,c.length);
		  if (value) {
		  	var split_value = value.split("|", 3);
		  	if (split_value.length > 0) {
			  CQuotient.cquid=split_value[0];
		  	}
		  	if (split_value.length > 1) {
			  CQuotient.cqeid=split_value[1];
		  	}
		  	if (split_value.length > 2) {
			  CQuotient.cqlid=split_value[2];
		  	}
		  }
	  }
	}
}
CQuotient.getCQCookieId = function () {
	if(window.CQuotient.cqcid == '')
		window.CQuotient.initFromCookies();
	return window.CQuotient.cqcid;
};
CQuotient.getCQUserId = function () {

		window.CQuotient.initFromCookies();

};

};

};

try {
	if (Object.prototype.toString.call(events) === "[object Array]") {

	} else {
		CQuotient._trackASingleCQEvent(events);
	}
} catch(err) {}
};
CQuotient._trackASingleCQEvent = function ( /* Object */ event) {
	if (event && event.id) {
		if (event.type === dw.ac.EV_PRD_DETAIL) {
			CQuotient.trackViewProduct( {id:'', alt_id: event.id, type: 'raw_sku'} );
		} // not handling the other dw.ac.* events currently
	}
};
CQuotient.trackViewProduct = function(/* Object */ cqParamData){
	var cq_params = {};
	cq_params.cookieId = CQuotient.getCQCookieId();
	cq_params.userId = CQuotient.getCQUserId();

	cq_params.instanceType = cqParamData.instanceType;
	cq_params.locale = CQuotient.locale;
	
	if(CQuotient.sendActivity) {
		CQuotient.sendActivity(CQuotient.clientId, 'viewProduct', cq_params);
	} else {
		CQuotient.activities.push({activityType: 'viewProduct', parameters: cq_params});
	}
};

    (function() {
        window.CQuotient.widgets = window.CQuotient.widgets || [];
        const nativePush = window.CQuotient.widgets.push;

        function checkEmptyRecommendationSlots(args) {
            const recommSlots = document.querySelectorAll('div[id^="cq_recomm_slot-"]');
            recommSlots.forEach(slot => {
                const skeletonParent = slot.closest('.c-skeleton__loading');
                if (skeletonParent) {
                    const scriptInfo = skeletonParent.querySelectorAll('script');
                    const isSlot = Array.from(scriptInfo).some(script => 
                        script.textContent.includes(args.slotId)
                    );

                    const isEmpty = slot.children.length === 0 && slot.textContent.trim() === '';
                    if (isSlot && isEmpty) {
                        const skeletonChild = skeletonParent.querySelector('.skeleton-container');
                        skeletonChild.style.display = 'none';
                        skeletonParent.classList.add('no-recomendations');
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        window.CQuotient.widgets.push = function(args) {
            if (args !== null && typeof args === 'object' && args.recommenderName && args.callback && typeof args.callback === 'function') {
                const originalCallback = args.callback;
                const argsP = args.parameters;

                args.callback = function(response) {
                    let productRecommendations = null;
                    let args = argsP;
                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (Array.isArray(response.recs)) {
                            productRecommendations = response.recs;
                        } else {
                            const innerObjectWithRecs = Object.values(response).find(item => item !== null && typeof item === 'object' && Array.isArray(item.recs));
                            if (innerObjectWithRecs) {
                                productRecommendations = innerObjectWithRecs.recs;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (!productRecommendations || productRecommendations.length === 0) {
                        checkEmptyRecommendationSlots(args);
                    }
                    return originalCallback.apply(this, arguments);
                };
            }
            return nativePush.apply(window.CQuotient.widgets, [args]);
        };
    })();
</script>
